text:
One ice cube is placed on a metal block. An identical ice cube is placed on a plastic block. The
blocks are left next to each other on a table in a laboratory.
ice cube
metal block
plastic block
Which ice cube melts first and why?
A
The ice cube on the plastic block melts first because plastic is a good insulator of thermal
energy.
B
The ice cube on the plastic block melts first because plastic is a good conductor of thermal
energy.
C
The ice cube on the metal block melts first because metal is a good conductor of thermal
energy.
D
The ice cube on the metal block melts first because metal is a good insulator of thermal
energy.
